{"id":1849574230,"question_id":4119,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765135870,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"194 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1849574230/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements II","memory":"247.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumDistance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<pair<int,int>>mp;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            mp.push_back({nums[i] , i});\n        }\n\n        sort(mp.begin() , mp.end());\n\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        \n        for(int i=0 ; i < n-2 ; i++)\n        {\n            if(mp[i].first == mp[i+1].first and mp[i+1].first == mp[i+2].first)\n            {\n                int d1 = mp[i].second;\n                int d2 = mp[i+1].second;\n                int d3 = mp[i+2].second;\n\n                int distance = abs(d1 - d2) + abs(d2 - d3) + abs(d3 - d1);\n                ans = min(ans , distance);\n            } \n        }\n        return ans == INT_MAX ? -1 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-distance-between-three-equal-elements-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1271}
